meta.description: Draw and export phylogenetic trees with Bio.Phylo plus matplotlib, and route rich figures to ggtree, ETE4, or iTOL. Covers layout choice (cladogram/phylogram/chronogram), ladderization, labelling support by its measure, BEAST HPD bars via treeio + ggtree, and tip-count and raster-vs-vector thresholds.
meta.executed: 7/7 inputs executed (Biopython 1.88, matplotlib 3.11.1, IQ-TREE 2.4.0, MrBayes 3.2.7a, R 4.4.3 with ggtree 3.14.0 / treeio 1.30.0 / ggtreeExtra 1.16.0 / ggplot2 4.0.3 / ape); iTOL and FigTree not executed (web/GUI)
meta.execution_note: All data are SYNTHETIC (data/make_data.py): a 16-taxon primate-named tree simulated with AliSim and re-inferred by IQ-TREE 2.4.0 (SH-aLRT/UFBoot labels, RF to truth = 0), a MrBayes 3.2.7a consensus on the same alignment, a 320-tip DendroPy birth-death tree with invented metadata, and a hand-written BEAST2/TreeAnnotator-format MCC Nexus with known node ages and height_95%_HPD. All three shipped examples ran as written (exit 0). ETE4 could not be installed (pip build fails compiling ete4/core/operations.pyx on Python 3.12 Windows); ete3 3.1.3 rendered headlessly only after installing PyQt5 with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen and the PNG carried no tip-name text. In this R stack ggtree layouts slanted/equal_angle/daylight/ape, geom_tiplab(align=TRUE) and gheatmap() crash (ggtree 3.14 vs ggplot2 4.0.3, e.g. 'could not find function is.waive'); outputs were adapted (ape unrooted plot, ggtreeExtra geom_fruit) and the failures recorded.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations or results. Every support value, posterior and node age in the figures came from the synthetic IQ-TREE, MrBayes and BEAST-format files. The invented trait table and host metadata are labelled synthetic in the figure captions.

practice_boundaries.detail: Tree drawing for research only; nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled fallacy: support measures were never equated (PP vs bootstrap kept separate, the joint SH-aLRT/UFBoot rule applied), and the basal-taxon claim on an unrooted layout was refused. Two display errors (support labels shifted after Bio.Phylo rerooting in Input 1; HPD bars re-centred by geom_range in Input 4) were found by auditor checks and scored as correctness failures, not as fallacies.

code_usability.detail: Every Skill snippet and all 3 examples parse and run on Biopython 1.88 / matplotlib 3.11.1; geom_range('height_0.95_HPD') runs on ggtree 3.14. Failures were silent-output defects, not unrunnable code. The R crashes come from a ggtree 3.14 / ggplot2 4.0.3 incompatibility in the environment, and each was worked around.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3: Bio.Phylo recipes are complete, but ggtree/ETE4/iTOL get routing text plus one geom_range line, with no code for dual support, heatmaps or circular rings. Correctness 2: support_label reads only clade.confidence, so it draws nothing on an IQ-TREE 'SH-aLRT/UFBoot' treefile (labels land in clade.name). 'Plain Newick tree has no color slot' is false (Clade.color works). The ax.axis('off') recipe deletes the only branch-length scale while the thresholds table calls a scale bar mandatory. Appropriateness 3.

reliability.note: Fault tolerance 2: nothing warns that dual labels go to .name, that Bio.Phylo rerooting moves node-held support to the wrong branch, or that geom_range re-centres asymmetric HPDs. Error reporting 3: Common Errors table with cause/solution. Recoverability 3: introspect-and-adapt rule.

performance_context.note: 231-line SKILL.md with dense conceptual prose and tables, loaded at once; no redundant steps.

agent_usability.note: Learnable, with a strong doctrine: declare layout, units, ordering and support measure in the caption. The support recipe hard-codes 'Bootstrap' in its comment and title. Error prevention misses the three silent failure modes found in execution.

human_usability.note: Usage guide has natural prompts (800 tips, BEAST HPD bars, dual support). Forgiveness 2: the most common modern input (IQ-TREE dual labels) silently yields a figure with no support and a title that claims bootstrap support.

security.note: No credentials or network; examples write to tempfile.mkdtemp, not the CWD. File paths are used without validation, which is minor for a plotting skill.

maintainability.note: Examples are self-contained with inline trees and run unchanged, but ship no expected output. Version block pins lower bounds only (ggtree 3.12+) and misses the ggplot2 4.x breakage.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and clean routing to tree-io, tree-manipulation, ggplot2-fundamentals and multipanel-figures (all four sibling skills exist). Idempotent. Escape hatches for circular/HPD needs, but no stop signal for annotated trees read by Bio.Phylo beyond prose.

key_strengths: Sound figure doctrine: layout, branch-length unit, ordering disclaimer and support measure must be declared, and PP is never equated with bootstrap
Correct tool routing for annotated Bayesian trees: treeio read.beast exposes height_0.95_HPD exactly as documented and Bio.Phylo indeed draws none of it
Thresholds table (tip counts, vector export, 600 dpi, SH-aLRT/UFBoot/PP cut-offs) led to the right layout and export choices
All three shipped examples run unchanged, write to temp dirs, and label bootstrap support by its measure
Clean scope: rooting, pruning and collapsing are routed to sibling Skills that exist

recommendations.title: support_label ignores IQ-TREE dual labels in clade.name
recommendations.problem: On an IQ-TREE 2 treefile, support_label (reads only clade.confidence) draws 0 labels under a title claiming bootstrap support, while default draw() prints raw '88.5/92' strings with no measure.
recommendations.root_cause: The recipe assumes a single numeric label that Bio.Phylo parses into .confidence; 'a/b' labels are kept as the clade name.
recommendations.fix: Add a parser: if clade.name matches r'^[\d.]+/[\d.]+$', split into SH-aLRT/UFBoot, set clade.name=None and label 'SH/UF'. Drop the hard-coded 'Bootstrap' title and warn when no internal clade has confidence.

recommendations.title: Warn that Bio.Phylo rerooting shifts node-held support
recommendations.problem: After Tree.root_with_outgroup, 7 of 13 SH-aLRT/UFBoot labels sat on the wrong bipartition; the figure looked plausible.
recommendations.root_cause: Support is a branch property stored on nodes; the Skill routes rooting elsewhere and says nothing about label transfer.
recommendations.fix: In 'Unlabeled or Mislabeled Support', state that support must be re-attached by bipartition after rerooting in Bio.Phylo (or root with treeio::root(edgelabel=TRUE) / ape root(edgelabel=TRUE)), and verify by split.

recommendations.title: geom_range default re-centres asymmetric HPD bars
recommendations.problem: geom_range('height_0.95_HPD') keeps the bar width but centres it on the node age, misplacing asymmetric 95% HPDs by up to 4.95 Ma on a 318 Ma tree.
recommendations.root_cause: ggtree's center='auto' default is not mentioned in the Skill's HPD recipe.
recommendations.fix: Write the recipe as geom_range('height_0.95_HPD', center='height') (verified exact) and tell the agent to check one bar against the annotation.

recommendations.title: Scaled-panel recipe removes scale and ignores own thresholds
recommendations.problem: For 320 tips the recipe produces a 10 x 80 in figure, and ax.axis('off') deletes the branch-length axis, which is Bio.Phylo's only scale, against the 'scale bar mandatory' row.
recommendations.root_cause: The recipe was written for moderate trees and was not checked against the thresholds table.
recommendations.fix: Keep the x axis (hide only y ticks/spines), cap the height and point to circular/strips above ~150 tips; say Bio.Phylo has no scale-bar artist, so the axis is the scale.

recommendations.title: Correct the 'plain Newick tree has no color slot' row
recommendations.problem: Bio.Phylo BaseTree.Clade accepts .color on a Newick-read tree and draw() renders it; conversion to phyloXML is unnecessary.
recommendations.root_cause: The Common Errors row was not checked against Biopython 1.83+.
recommendations.fix: Replace the row with: 'set clade.color on the MRCA clade (inherits to descendants); as_phyloxml() only needed for phyloXML export'.

recommendations.title: Pin the ggtree/ggplot2 combination
recommendations.problem: With ggtree 3.14 and ggplot2 4.0.3, slanted/equal_angle/daylight/ape layouts, geom_tiplab(align=TRUE) and gheatmap() crash; the Skill claims these layouts for 'ggtree 3.12+'.
recommendations.root_cause: The version block lists lower bounds only and no ggplot2 constraint.
recommendations.fix: State the tested ggtree/ggplot2 pair, and name the fallbacks: ape plot.phylo(type='unrooted'), geom_fruit instead of gheatmap.

recommendations.title: Add ggtree code patterns for the rich-figure path
recommendations.problem: The recommended publication path (dual support legend, heatmap/rings, clade bars, group colouring) has no code, so layer placement errors (clade bar over labels, groupOTU stem colouring, clipped caption) went unguarded.
recommendations.root_cause: Code depth is concentrated in the Bio.Phylo path the Skill itself calls unsuitable for publication.
recommendations.fix: Add one tested read.iqtree -> root(edgelabel=TRUE) -> geom_nodelab(SH_aLRT/UFboot) -> geom_fruit -> geom_cladelab -> ggsave example, plus the groupOTU stem-branch caveat.

recommendations.title: State ETE4 install and headless limits
recommendations.problem: ete4 does not build from pip on Windows Python 3.12. ete3 renders headlessly only with PyQt5 and QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, and then emits no text.
recommendations.root_cause: ETE4 is recommended for headless rendering without install or platform notes.
recommendations.fix: Note the Qt requirement and the offscreen font caveat, and suggest ggtree for headless CI rendering.
